title: Core configuration with output summary
statement: For a configuration of a $k$-tape Turing machine on a fixed Boolean input, form the ordered pair consisting of its core configuration data (state, input-head position, work-tape contents, and work-head positions) and the output summary of its output string.
caveat: The referenced core projection is not defined in the supplied snippet; its component fields are inferred from the configuration definition.
